correctness.rationale: On fully occupied K_{a,b}, changing the within-part weighted symmetric distance sums by a cross swap equals the sum of the two participants individual neighbor-average cost reductions; each strict beneficial swap increases that potential, proving finite improvement. The complete 21-partition K_{2,5} witness on integer-scaled types (0,0,0,0,1,3,4) has minimum cross cost 15 and minimum across equilibria 17; direct independent rational enumeration verified all seven type profiles. Correct proof and value of the mathematical identity do not establish originality.

value.rationale: FAIL: the 2 November published complete-bipartite continuous-type theorem states exactly the same potential identity, finite improvement conclusion and even the identical seven-agent K_{2,5} witness with PoS 17/15.
